title: Binance to Close Accounts in Four EU Countries Dec. 31, Charging Idle Balances From Nov. 29
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Binance to Close Accounts in Four EU Countries Dec. 31, Charging Idle Balances From Nov. 29 Binance told users in France, Spain, Italy and Poland to withdraw their crypto, with deposits blocked, accounts closing Dec. 31 and a monthly fee starting Nov. 29, as the exchange still lacks an EU license. This post Binance to Close Accounts in Four EU Countries Dec. 31, Charging Idle Balances From Nov. 29 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
